key.name: log-entries
key.description: How many of the latest client messages the menu shows. At most 30 so that the menu fits on the screen.

key.name: file-operations-only
key.summary: Show only file operations under “Recent Messages”
key.description: If set, only uploads, downloads, deletions, moves and created folders are listed. Otherwise all client messages except recurring routine lines are listed.

key.name: account-names
key.description: Name shown in the menu for each account, by systemd unit. Without an entry, the address used to sign in is shown.

key.name: login-names
key.description: The address last used to sign in to each account, by systemd unit. Set by the sign-in window.

key.name: known-accounts
key.description: The systemd units of the accounts the extension has found, for the preferences window.
